race.comment: Connections had such a high opinion of OREGON COAST (9) that they debuted her in a G3 race at Rosehill where she certainly wasn't disgraced. Followed that up with a runner-up effort at Eagle Farm behind a pretty smart one before being tipped out for further time to furnish. Tuned up for this with two recent trials and should be right there at the business end. COMPEL (2) is facing the starter for the first time but looked handy winning a trial here and Maloney stays on top for race day. Include. METRIC (5) has been right there in all three career efforts and maps ideally for this from gate two. Top-three aspirations. The well-related PIERANTES (10) (half to G1 winner Startantes) is sure to be well-educated out of the Heathcote barn and should be kept very safe. SUMMER SENSATION (11) gets in light for the claim and is one for the multiples.
